title: 第1章 平林村第2章 逃命
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 鸿蒙大陆东面偏僻处，一个原本平静的小村正在经历本不该承受的浩劫。
满盘银月之下，数不清的黑影在树林中飞快窜动，只露出一双双猩红的眼眸。
平林村一老农正前往村后水井打算挑水，抬头骤然对上密密麻麻的红眸，当即吓得肝胆欲裂，一把将肩上的扁担水桶摔在地上，他转身便要逃，口中也大喊，“有妖狼——”
然而他才转过身，身后的黑影就已经闪到他背后，巨大的狼口一张，森然的尖牙露出，老农半截身子便没了，呼喊也戛然而止。
住在附近被老农惊呼引动的村民打开院门，见着的便是老农掉在地上的双腿，以及尖牙鲜血滴答的巨狼。
他脑子嗡的一下停住，直到冰冷的红眸看向他，才如梦初醒猛地砰一下关上门。
但村里低矮脆弱的院门院墙压根抵挡不住巨大的妖狼。
妖狼只轻身一跃，便跨过院门，一爪子拍下，村民瞬间被开膛破肚没了气息，甚至都来不及呼喊。
屋中女人走出，被眼前的一幕震惊，控制不住放声尖叫，直冲云霄。
下一刻，女人也被一口咬死。
女人的尖叫惊动了整个村子，许多村民纷纷打开院门张望。
“怎么回事，我怎么听到了丽娘的尖叫？”
“是啊，她怎么了？”
“我去看看？”
还没等他们商量好谁去看，远处巨大的狼一跳，稳稳落在了村中央，猩红的眼眸四处搜索着猎物。
这下，所有人都知道发生了什么。
“妖狼！
是妖狼，快躲起来！”
“快跑啊！”
有的村民选择躲起来，有的村民选择逃出村子，就在村中一片混乱时，一个小小的身影慢慢从林子中走出，她皮肤惨白，身形瘦弱，穿着一身褐色麻布衣裤，及腰的头发湿哒哒披散着，年龄看去不过六七岁。
巫未央洗完澡从溪边回村时，见到的就是妖狼左一口，右一爪的血腥场面。
她站在林子边，脑袋有片刻的空白。
“嗷呜~”
一声声狼嚎将她唤醒，巫未央回神，乌溜溜的大眼睛瞅见屋顶上或院墙上数不清的黑影，意识到现在相当危险。
她清瘦的小手扶住旁边的树木，开始慢慢往后退。
可惜上天没能眷顾她，在狼群边缘的几头妖狼嗅到了她的气息，转过了头来。
与瘆人的红眸对上，巫未央心尖颤动了一下，咬牙转身就跑。
三头妖狼立马追上。
妖狼的速度很快，但它们不像头狼那样身形巨大，只略微比寻常的狼大一些，不至于一跃便是半个村子，这给了巫未央一点喘息空间。
但这一点是真一点。
content_en:
In a remote place to the east of Hongmeng Continent, a small village that was originally peaceful is experiencing a catastrophe that it should not have to endure.
"Ouch~~"
Under the silvery moon, countless black shadows were moving rapidly in the woods, revealing only pairs of scarlet eyes.
An old farmer in Pinglin Village was going to the well behind the village to fetch water. He suddenly looked up and saw dense red eyes. He was so frightened that he threw the bucket on his shoulder to the ground. He turned around and wanted to run away, shouting, "There is a demon wolf——"
However, as soon as he turned around, the black shadow behind him had already flashed behind him. The huge wolf's mouth opened, and its sharp fangs were exposed. Half of the old farmer's body was gone, and his shouting suddenly stopped.
The villagers who lived nearby and were attracted by the old farmer's exclamation opened the door to the courtyard. What they saw were the old farmer's legs that had fallen to the ground, and the giant wolf with its fangs dripping with blood.
His mind stopped for a moment, until cold red eyes looked at him, and then he slammed the door shut as if waking up from a dream.
But the low and fragile courtyard gates and walls in the village could not withstand the huge demonic wolf at all.
The demon wolf only jumped lightly and crossed the courtyard gate. With a paw, the villagers were instantly disemboweled and breathless, and they didn't even have time to shout.
"Ah!
——”
The woman in the house walked out and was shocked by the scene in front of her. She couldn't help but scream loudly, soaring into the sky.
The next moment, the woman was also bitten to death.
The woman's scream shocked the whole village, and many villagers opened their courtyard doors to look around.
"What's going on? Why did I hear Liniang's scream?"
"Yeah, what happened to her?"
"Shall I go take a look?"
"Let's go together..."
Before they could decide who would watch, the huge wolf in the distance jumped and landed firmly in the center of the village, its scarlet eyes searching for prey everywhere.
Now, everyone knew what happened.
"Demon wolf!
It's a demon wolf, hide now! "
"Run!"
"Ah!
! "
Some villagers chose to hide, and some chose to escape from the village. When the village was in chaos, a small figure slowly walked out of the woods. She had pale skin and a thin figure. She was wearing brown linen clothes and trousers. Her waist-length hair was wet and disheveled. She looked to be no more than six or seven years old.
When Wu Weiyang returned to the village from the stream after taking a bath, what he saw was the bloody scene of the demon wolf taking a bite from the left and clawing from the right.
She stood at the edge of the forest, her mind blank for a moment.
"Ouch~"
A wolf howl woke her up, and Wu Weiyang came back to her senses. Her big dark eyes saw countless black figures on the roof or on the courtyard wall, and she realized that it was quite dangerous now.
She held onto the trees next to her with her thin hands and began to retreat slowly.
It's a pity that God failed to favor her. Several demon wolves on the edge of the wolf pack smelled her breath and turned their heads.
Facing the terrifying red eyes, Wu Weiyang's heart trembled, gritted his teeth, turned around and ran away.
The three demon wolves immediately caught up.
The speed of the demon wolves is very fast, but they are not as huge as the alpha wolf. They are only slightly larger than ordinary wolves and cannot cover half of the village in one leap. This gives Wu Weiyang some breathing space.
But this is true.
